desc: Controller parity (TTYD_BINDINGS_PARITY): every one of Paper Cut's actions has a controller binding by default or a menu way (the settings page, the Start menu, a touch button), listed once at start; the same check as testpass lint's (tools/port/pad_parity.py), here on the built table
